original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Deploy Java application as systemd service
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    app_name: myapp
    app_user: "{{ app_name }}"
    app_group: "{{ app_name }}"
    app_jar_source: /path/to/your/application.jar
    app_jar_dest: /opt/{{ app_name }}/{{ app_name }}.jar
    app_java_home: /usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64
    app_service_description: "{{ app_name }} Java Application Service"

  tasks:
    - name: Install OpenJDK 21
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: openjdk-21-jdk
        state: present
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Create application user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: yes
        create_home: no
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        state: present

    - name: Create application directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /opt/{{ app_name }}
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Copy application JAR
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ app_jar_source }}"
        dest: "{{ app_jar_dest }}"
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: '0644'
        force: no

    - name: Write systemd unit file
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: app.service.j2
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ app_name }}.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      notify: reload systemd and restart service

    - name: Enable and start service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        enabled: yes
        state: started
        daemon_reload: yes

  handlers:
    - name: reload systemd and restart service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        daemon_reload: yes
        state: restarted
